title: Tic Tac Toe: Undo, AI Opponent, and Scoring
description: Add move history for undo, minimax AI, and a scoring system.

data.text: Extend tic tac toe to support undo (move history), a minimax AI opponent, and a scoring system that tracks wins, losses, and draws.

data.title: MoveHistory and Minimax AI
Minimax depth penalty
data.text: Subtract depth from winning score and add depth to losing score. This makes the AI prefer faster wins and slower losses, producing more natural play.

data.title: Key Takeaways
points: Minimax explores all future board states
Depth penalty makes AI prefer shorter games
Separate AI class keeps Game clean
data.takeaway: Adding undo and AI turns a simple game into an extensible system. Undo is just a move stack. AI is minimax with board cloning.
